**AC** 13 | **HP** 26 (4d10 + 4) | **Speed** 50 ft.
**STR** 16 (+3) | **DEX** 13 (+1) | **CON** 13 (+1) | **INT** 7 (-2) | **WIS** 11 (+0) | **CHA** 8 (-1)
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +4
